SAME OPERATION
(behaviour: embeds a diagnostic message borrowed from another library/exception verbatim into a finding's `message`, the exact pattern `_model_findings` was patched to bound)

- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py:331 `_run_guarded` — builds `f"{crash_label} crashed unexpectedly ({type(exc).__name__}: {exc}); this is a validator bug — please report."` from an arbitrary caught `Exception`'s `str(exc)`, unbounded.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py:353 `main()` — builds `message=f"Cannot read document: {exc}"` from an `OSError`/`JSONDecodeError`/`UnicodeDecodeError`, unbounded.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:312 `_unreadable_as_2020_12` — returns `f"is not a valid JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 document: {exc.message}"` using `jsonschema.exceptions.SchemaError.message` unbounded — this is literally the same `jsonschema` library `_bounded()`'s own docstring (packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py:100-111) calls out as rendering the failing instance/keyword value whole.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:981 `_load_json_sibling` — builds `message=f"sibling {path.name} could not be read or parsed ({exc})."` from a caught OS/JSON error, unbounded.

Sites that already do the fixed-pattern operation correctly (bound the borrowed text), confirming the commit's "every other borrowed diagnostic … already is" claim:
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:397-398, 413, 416, 425, 441 `_embedded_schema_example_findings` — bounds `entry`/`node_ptr`, and jsonschema's `error["path"]`/`error["message"]`, an unresolved `$ref`, and a crash `detail`, all via `_bounded()`.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_sample_budget.py:276, 386 `BudgetedGrader.grade`/`_start` — bounds `str(exc)` from worker-process failures via `_bounded()`.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_sample_budget.py `_worker_stderr`, `_exchange` — bound the worker's stderr tail and malformed reply text via `_bounded()`.

Note: `_model_findings` (packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py:195-240) is the single, reused implementation of "validate against a contract model → findings" (its own docstring: "the single source of single-document validity, reused by every kind") — there is no parallel/duplicate implementation of that operation itself; the divergence found is only in the unrelated borrowed-diagnostic-bounding sites listed above.

CALLERS/CONSUMERS
(chain from the touched mechanism — `_model_findings`, `_type_map_discriminator_findings`, `_validate_type_map`, `type_map_findings`, `validate_document` — out to the repo boundary)

In-package:
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:1413 `_validate_type_map` — calls `_model_findings(doc, _TYPE_MAP_ADAPTER)` via `_type_map_discriminator_findings` (connectors.py:1412-1419), which now rewrites the `union_tag_not_found` message and appends `_UNGRADED_TAIL`.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:1441 `register_kind(lambda doc: isinstance(doc, dict) and "rules" in doc, _validate_type_map)` — wires the type-map detector/validator pair into `_KIND_REGISTRY`.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py `_dispatch`/`validate_document` — consult `_KIND_REGISTRY`, routing a bare document to `_validate_type_map` (the "standalone route").
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:1084, 1112, 1125 `check_coverage` — calls `type_map_findings(doc_, direction)` on sibling read/write maps located by their slot filename (the "package route" the commit's new probe `type-map-slot-grades-the-sibling` exercises); called from `_validate_connector` (connectors.py:1254-1258).
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/__init__.py:34-64 — re-exports `validate_document`, `type_map_findings`, `check_coverage` as the package's public surface (`analitiq.validator`).
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/_core.py:339-359 `main()` (CLI `analitiq-validate`) — calls `validate_document`, prints `{"passed", "findings"}`, so a discriminator finding's rewritten `message`/`path` reaches CI/agent stdout verbatim.

In-repo consumers (adapters over the package):
- scripts/render_validator_claims.py:135 `_validate` — calls `validate_document`, used by every `_p_*` probe function (e.g. `_p_type_map_slot_grades_the_sibling`, added at line 337, and `_p_type_map_direction_from_document`) whose `message_re`/PROBE assertions are what fence the connector-builder/pipeline-builder reference docs' prose against drift.
- plugins/analitiq-pipeline-builder/scripts/validate.py:220-296 `_type_map_findings`/its caller — calls the published `analitiq.validator` (via `validate_document`/`type_map_findings`) and at line 284 does `{**f, "path": f"{site}/{fname}{f.get('path', '')}"}`, concatenating the finding's `path` (the `/direction` root-rerouting `_type_map_discriminator_findings` performs) onto a file site — this is the exact "pipeline plugin's validate script concatenates it onto a file site" consumer the commit's updated docstring names.
- plugins/analitiq-pipeline-builder/scripts/type_map_gaps.py:74-90 `_load_rules` — imports `finding_costs_a_pass, type_map_findings` from `analitiq.validator`, calls `type_map_findings(doc, direction, scope="connection")`, and directly interpolates each finding's `f['message']` and `f.get('path')` into stderr output and a raised `ValueError` shown to the connector/pipeline author — a second, independent consumer of the discriminator message text and path.
- plugins/analitiq-connector-builder/agents/connector-schema-validator.md — agent instructions that `pip install`/invoke the published `analitiq-validator` console script and relay its Diagnostics JSON (including `message`/`path`) into the connector-builder plugin's authoring loop.
- plugins/analitiq-pipeline-builder/agents/pipeline-schema-validator.md — wraps `scripts/validate.py`, returning its Diagnostics JSON (built from the same `path`/`message` fields) verbatim to the pipeline-builder authoring loop.

Repo boundary (published artifact, confirmed via .github/workflows/validator-release.yml:1-9):
- `analitiq-validator` is built from `packages/validator/src` and published to PyPI on a `validator-vX.Y.Z` tag. The workflow's own comment: "Consumers (the connector-builder plugin, the registry CI) `pip install analitiq-validator` and run the `analitiq-validate` console script." Downstream consumers outside this repo are: DIP CI (sole registry gate), the engine runtime, and infra's `pipeline-invoker` Lambda — none of which live in this tree, so the chain cannot be verified further from here.
